history.body: Hi, I saw your Pearl Residences ad and am considering it as an investment. Could you share more details?

Sure. Pearl Residences is a freehold condominium in Seberang Jaya. Phase 1 Type A units are 900 sq.ft. with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony; expected completion is Q4 2029.

For an investment, the freehold tenure and known holding cost may be useful factors to weigh: maintenance is RM0.18 psf inclusive of sinking fund—about RM162/month for a 900 sq.ft. unit, for maintenance only. Are you mainly looking at rental income, longer-term capital growth, or a mix?
Mainly rental income. The RM162 monthly maintenance is helpful to know. What’s the expected unit price, and do you have nearby rental comparables to estimate whether the numbers could work?

For an initial benchmark, the pricing reference shows base prices around RM328k–RM358k, depending on the unit category and floor. That isn’t a confirmed current all-in price; the exact unit, car-park configuration and applicable package can change the figure. I don’t have verified nearby rental comparables to estimate rent or yield reliably, so I’ll verify those along with the latest unit pricing rather than guess. We can then compare the figures against the RM162/month maintenance, before allowing for vacancy, other costs and financing.
